response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: Passing the 47.6 cutoff means bandwidth usage is strictly greater than 47.6.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is inclusive, include telescopes with bandwidth usage equal to 47.6.
alternatives.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is inclusive, include telescopes with bandwidth usage equal to 47.6.
